Rashi on Megillah 15b:10:1.hebrew: אמתה של בת פרעה - "ותשלח את אמתה ותקחה" (שמות ב׳:ה׳):
Rashi on Megillah 15b:10:1.english: The arm of Pharaoh's daughter - [As it is written:] "And she stretched out her arm and took it" (Exodus 2:5):

Rashi on Megillah 15b:10:2.hebrew: בשיני רשעים - עוג מלך הבשן, במס' ברכות פרק הרואה (ברכות דף נד:) [שעקר הר בת ג' פרסי להשליכו על ישראל, ונתנו על ראשו, ושלח הקב"ה נמלים ונקבוהו, ונכנס בצוארו; בקש לשומטו, ונשתרבבו שיניו לכאן ולכאן]:
Rashi on Megillah 15b:10:2.english: With the teeth of the wicked - [This refers to] Og, king of Bashan, in Tractate Berakhot, chapter HaRo'eh (Berakhot 54b) [who uprooted a mountain three parasangs [wide] to hurl it upon Israel and placed it upon his head; and the Holy One, blessed be He, sent ants and they bored through it, and it slipped onto his neck; he sought to pull it off, and his teeth stretched out on both sides]:

Rashi on Megillah 15b:10:3.hebrew: אל תקרי שברת אלא שרבבת - גרסינן. ומשיני רשעים נפיק להאי דרשה, דליכתוב קרא "ושן רשע", אלא י' דשיני וי"ם דרשעים, הרי ששים:
Rashi on Megillah 15b:10:3.english: Do not read [it as] shibbarta [“You have broken”], but [as] sheribavta [“You have enlarged”] - This is the reading [in our Gemara text]. And this exposition is derived from [the words] “the teeth of the wicked” [shinei resha'im]: for [otherwise] the verse should have written “and the tooth of a wicked [person]” [in the singular]; rather, [the letter] yud [10] of shinei and [the letters] yud-mem [10 + 40 = 50] of resha'im — behold, [together they equal] sixty:

Rashi on Megillah 15b:11:1.hebrew: ולא דבר שחוצץ במלכות - בנין הבית, שהוא באמצע של עולם, כדאמרי' בסדר יומא (דף נד:): אבן שתיה, שממנה נשתת העולם:
Rashi on Megillah 15b:11:1.english: And not something that divides the kingdom - [That is,] the building of the Temple, which is in the center of the world, as we say in Seder Yoma (54b): [It is the] Foundation Stone, from which the world was founded:

Rashi on Megillah 15b:13:1.english: She learned from her father’s house - She heard the children saying so:

Rashi on Megillah 15b:13:2.english: And rebel - against the king, for his fortune was prospering:

Rashi on Megillah 15b:14:1.english: That he be on hand for her - Perhaps she would be able to cause him to stumble in some matter before the king.

Rashi on Megillah 15b:14:2.hebrew: ירגיש הקב"ה - שאף אני מקרבת שונאיהן של ישראל, אי נמי, ירגיש שאני צריכה להחניף רשע זה ולזלזל בכבודי:
Rashi on Megillah 15b:14:2.english: The Holy One, blessed be He, will take notice - [meaning] that even I am drawing near the enemies of Israel; or else, He will take notice that I must flatter this wicked man and degrade my honor:

Rashi on Megillah 15b:15:1.hebrew: שיהרג הוא והיא - שיחשדני המלך ממנו ויהרוג את שנינו. [נ"א: וכי גזרי גזירה ומית חד מינייהו, בטלי הגזירה]:
Rashi on Megillah 15b:15:1.english: That he and she would be killed - That the king will suspect me with him and kill both of us. [Variant reading: And when they issue a decree and one of them dies, the decree is annulled]:

Rashi on Megillah 15b:15:2.hebrew: מלך הפכפך היה - וחוזר בדיבורו, אמרה: שמא אוכל לפתותו ולהורגו, ואם לא יהא מזומן, תעבור השעה ויחזור בו:
Rashi on Megillah 15b:15:2.english: He was a fickle king - and goes back on his word. [Esther] said [to herself]: "Perhaps I will be able to persuade him [the king] and kill him [Haman], and if he [Haman] is not present, the moment will pass and he [the king] will change his mind:"

Rashi on Megillah 15b:16:1.hebrew: בחומם אשית את משתיהם - על בלשצר וסיעתו נאמר, בשובם מן המלחמה — שדריוש וכורש היו צרין על בבל ונצחן בלשצר אותו היום — והיו עייפים וחמים, וישבו לשתות ונשתכרו, ובאותו היום נהרג. ואף אסתר אמרה: מתוך משתיהן של רשעים באה להם פורענות:
Rashi on Megillah 15b:16:1.english: When they are heated, I will make feasts for them - [This verse] was stated concerning Belshazzar and his company, upon their return from war — for Darius and Cyrus were besieging Babylon, and Belshazzar defeated them that day — and they were weary and heated, so they sat down to drink and became drunk, and on that day he was killed. And Esther likewise said: From the midst of the feasts of the wicked, calamity comes upon them.

Rashi on Megillah 15b:18:1.english: Those that were full have hired themselves out for bread - Yonatan translated [it as referring] to the sons of Haman:

Rashi on Megillah 15b:1:1.hebrew: בוטי - לשון עניות, כמו "והעבט תעביטנו" (דברים טו), כדאיתא במסכת גיטין (דף לז.):
Rashi on Megillah 15b:1:1.english: Butei - An expression of poverty, like [the verse], "you shall surely lend him [ha'avet ta'avitenu]" (Deuteronomy 15[:8]), [as found] in Tractate Gittin (37a):

Rashi on Megillah 15b:1:2.hebrew: בטולמי - נהמא, בככרות לחם; "עשרים לחם שעורים" (מלכים ב ד) מתרגמינן "עשרין טולמין דלחמא":
Rashi on Megillah 15b:1:2.english: For tulmei [be-tulmei] - [Meaning] bread, for loaves of bread; [the verse] "twenty [loaves of] barley bread" (II Kings 4[:42]) is translated [in Aramaic as] "twenty tulmin of bread":

Rashi on Megillah 15b:20:1.hebrew: שנת מלכו של עולם - דוגמא: "ויקץ כישן ה'" (תהילים ע״ח:ס״ה), לנקום נקמתו:
Rashi on Megillah 15b:20:1.english: The sleep of the King of the universe - [This is] similar [to], "Then the Lord awoke as one asleep" (Psalms 78:65), to exact His vengeance:

Rashi on Megillah 15b:20:2.hebrew: נדדו עליונים - שהיו מלאכים מבהילים אותו כל הלילה, ואמרו לו: "כפוי טובה, שלם טובה למי שעשאה" — לשון מורי. ויש אומרים: [נדדו עליונים] כדי שירבו בתחנונים לבקש על הדבר:
Rashi on Megillah 15b:20:2.english: The higher ones were disturbed - For angels were terrifying him all night, and saying to him, "Ingrate! Repay the favor to the one who did it!" — [this is] the wording of my teacher. And some say: [the higher ones were disturbed] so that they would multiply supplications to plead concerning the matter:

Rashi on Megillah 15b:21:1.hebrew: מאי דקמן דזמינתיה - כלומר, מה זאת הבאה לפני עכשיו, דבר חדש כזה:
Rashi on Megillah 15b:21:1.english: What is [this] before us that she has invited him - That is to say: what is this that has come before me now, such a new thing as this:

Rashi on Megillah 15b:22:1.hebrew: כתוב - משמע שהיה כתוב מחדש; "כתב" משמע מעיקרא. וימצא כתוב ספר זכרון לפניו אשר הגיד מרדכי:
Rashi on Megillah 15b:22:1.english: Written [katuv] - implies that it was written anew, [whereas] "a writing [ketav]" implies [that it had been written] from earlier; [this refers to the verse:] "And it was found written [in] the book of records before him that which Mordecai had told."

Rashi on Megillah 15b:4:1.english: For a spirit of justice - For those who judge their spirit, [God] will be a crown.

Rashi on Megillah 15b:4:2.english: Judges his [evil] inclination - He forces it to repent:

Rashi on Megillah 15b:4:3.english: And [one who] triumphs over his inclination - he does not follow after it to commit a transgression:

Rashi on Megillah 15b:4:4.hebrew: שמשכימין כו' - והיינו "שערה", שעושין [שנעשים שוערים] לפתוח דלתות בהשכמה, ולאחר [שם עד] זמן נעילתו:
Rashi on Megillah 15b:4:4.english: Who arrive early, etc. - And this is [the meaning of] "to the gate": that they act [become gatekeepers] to open the doors early in the morning, and to stay late [there until] the time of its closing:

Rashi on Megillah 15b:6:1.english: These also - these [are] the wicked who are judged in Gehenna:

Rashi on Megillah 15b:6:2.hebrew: ביין שגו - כלומר, אף הם עשו כהם, לפיכך דנם:
Rashi on Megillah 15b:6:2.english: Reel through wine - That is to say, they [Israel] also acted like them [the nations of the world]; therefore He judges them:

Rashi on Megillah 15b:6:3.english: They stumble in judgment - They were sentenced to Gehenna:

Rashi on Megillah 15b:7:1.english: My God, my God, why have You forsaken me - It is in the psalm [entitled] "Ayelet HaShachar" [Psalms 22]:

Rashi on Megillah 15b:7:2.hebrew: על אונס - [אע"פ] שאני באה אליו מאלי, אונס הוא:
Rashi on Megillah 15b:7:2.english: For [an act done under] compulsion - Even though I am coming to him on my own, it is [nonetheless] under compulsion:

Rashi on Megillah 15b:8:1.english: Deliver my soul from the sword - It is in that same psalm:

Tosafot on Megillah 15b:10:1.hebrew: [ה"ג אל תקרי שברת אלא שרבבת - ל' אשתרבובי (סוכה ה.), ול"ג שריבבת]:
Tosafot on Megillah 15b:10:1.english: [This is the reading: "Do not read shibbarta, rather shirbavta"] - [This is an] expression of ishtarbuvei [stretching out] (Sukkah 5a), and we do not read sheribavta:

Tosafot on Megillah 15b:4:1.hebrew: זה הדן דין אמת לאמתו - נראה דמשום הכי נקט "אמת", לאשמועינן דבדין מרומה צריך לחקור העדים בטוב עד שיתבאר האמת, ואז ידונו אותו לאמתו:
Tosafot on Megillah 15b:4:1.english: This [refers to] one who judges an absolutely true judgment - It appears that for this reason [the Gemara] stated "true," to teach us that in a fraudulent lawsuit one must interrogate the witnesses thoroughly until the truth becomes clear, and then they will judge it according to its truth:
